**San Marco Gelateria in Tirol**

Discover the authentic Italian taste of artisanal gelato in the heart of **Tirol**. At **Eiscafe San Marco**, we craft every scoop with the finest ingredients, just like in Italy. Indulge in creamy flavors like pistachio, stracciatella, and our famous **Kaiserschmarrn** gelato—fluffy, caramelized, and irresistibly sweet.

Whether you’re strolling through **Innsbruck** or exploring the alpine landscapes, our café offers a cozy retreat with homemade treats and a touch of Dolomite charm. Visit us for a moment of pure happiness—one delicious spoonful at a time.
